I reviewed w167 and the result is **DONE**: nothing needs fixing now and there is no Critical finding.

- **The change:** capability-proposals written from an integrate round's change list now carry the initiative's name in their id (`<context>/<initiative>-<capability>`). So two initiatives naming the same capability no longer share an id, as supervision r92 requires. To stop the new id causing a second work-item every run, the drafting step now matches existing work-items by the last part of the proposal's id. That keeps r72's "one work-item per capability".
- **The commit:** the `work/w167` branch is gone, so I read the merged commit `12f0b295`. Its code and tests are identical to `5fc3ed37`, the commit the implementer's result lists, as it was before the merge rebased it.
- **Tests:** no test was removed or weakened, nothing under `features/` changed, and the report claims no allowances. The two r92 scenarios pass. I did not run the full suite, since `work run` already did.
